text:
sam: Heads-up - Orion Cloud sent the final bundle for the marketplace listing + SI co-sell one-pager. links: https://drive.company/orion/orion-marketplace-bundle.zip and https://figma.com/file/orion-marketplace-dash

eden: quick check 14dd can design confirm we have both light & dark svg badges? Orion requires `orion-badge-light.svg` and `orion-badge-dark.svg` for marketplace tiles.

lio: we only have a PNG for the dark badge. asked Orion for svgs and the source Sketch file.

ana: Marketing note 4e2 - Marketplace metadata needs these fields: solution_type, use_cases (comma-separated), partner_tier. they sent "advanced-integration" as tier which doesn't map to our taxonomy. sam can you ask them to pick from: "Validated", "Strategic", "Premier"?

sam: Asked them to confirm tier mapping. also they included a customer case study but it has customer email addresses in the screenshots. need redaction before publish.

mkbot: [file uploaded] orion-badge-dark.png

eden: re: logo lockup - Orion asked that their SI partner logos appear on page 3 in a single row. We should follow our co-brand spacing rules; also check their brand guide for logo color use.

lio: Flagging legal: the case study includes a quote attributed to a third-party integrator that mentions performance numbers. need permission to publish those metrics.

ana: Also, AWS marketplace tile requires an 800x600 hero image with <10% text. current mock exceeds that. design to produce a compliant hero.

sam: Good catch. Timeline? Orion wants listing live by next Wednesday. Marketing needs assets by Monday COB.

eden: I'll export the hero variants (800x600 jpg) and produce badge svgs if Orion provides source. if not, I can vectorize but prefer official svgs.

lio: Orion replied: "We'll provide svgs and permission for the customer quote; see attached consent.pdf". They want the co-marketing to say "Joint solution with Redwood Inference and Orion Cloud" and asked to include their partner badge.

sam: Legal take? can we accept their phrasing? We usually avoid "joint solution" unless both sides sign off on the GTM.

lio: legal: "ok to publish 'Joint solution' language as long as the partner consent PDF is signed and we add the standard disclaimer: 'Availability and support provided by respective vendors.'"

mkbot: [file uploaded] consent.pdf

eden: small copy ask - in the one-pager header they used "deployed on-prem and in-cloud" -> change to "deployed on-premises and in cloud" for consistency with our style guide.

sam: noted. also add marketplace tags: "low-latency", "gpu-optimized", "private-deployment".

ana: Do we have permission to use Orion's case-study logo mosaic on the marketplace tile? some marketplaces limit logos on tiles to two brands. check marketplace rules.

sam: I'll confirm AWS marketplace logo policy. if restricted, we can use a single joint logo and link to the one-pager with the full mosaic.

lil (typo rename): ^^ sorry meant lio.

lio: final checklist I'll send to Orion when assets are ready: - Provide SVGs for badges and logos - Approve hero image variant (A or B) - Confirm partner tier mapping - Signed consent.pdf for quote and metrics - Permission to use customer logos in mosaic - Final copy approval

sam: Add file deliverables and deadlines to that checklist. thanks.

eden: Pushed updated Figma frames and hero variants: https://figma.com/file/orion-marketplace/frames (frames 8-10). will attach export links once ready.

mkbot: [file uploaded] hero-800x600-A.jpg

sam: Great work team. Once Orion confirms svgs and sign-off, marketing will queue the listing. Target publish window: Wednesday next week if we get everything by Monday 17:00 PST.

eden: I'll prepare the two badge color variants and the tile-safe hero tonight.

sam: closing loop here 44d will post a summary email to the Orion contact and cc legal/marketing once we have svgs.
